subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about retargeting browsers back into paid stays. With England's national short-term-let registration scheme due later in 2026, platforms will have to display a registration number and Vrbo-style listings of unregistered properties cannot stay live, so the addressable pool tightens and every shortlisted guest gets more valuable to recover. Retargeting CPAs already run roughly 15 to 25 dollars and cut acquisition cost up to 50 percent against cold, exactly where event screening and incrementality decide your true cost per paid booking. Worth comparing against your current source mix?
angle: fresh angle: England short-term-let registration scheme later 2026 (sourced) + travel retargeting CPA band $15-25
